task.description: WF-06 round 1, lens market: write runs/WF06-20260926-01/assessment-market.json per design §4.5 — score every candidate on demand_evidence and competition_gap, 1-5, each with at least one verbatim quote from runs/WF06-20260926-01/sources/.
acceptance_criteria: every quote is verbatim from a cleaned copy

result.summary: Round 1, lens market, 8 scores, each with verbatim quotes from cleaned copies (own check: 45 quotes, 0 not found, all sources in run.json). 01-kviz-zayavki: demand_evidence 4 (paid quiz market, modules sold in KZ for tenge; no KZ SMB cases), competition_gap 2 (15+ named competitors; Marquiz already has Telegram, Kazakh, result pages; only native WhatsApp-to-owner and tenge pricing free). 02-sai: demand_evidence 3 (returns problem asserted without sources in run; willingness to pay explicitly unproven), competition_gap 3 (AnyDress covers almost the whole no-website flow; TailorTalk/Dressie partial; no KZ service computing size + try-on found). 03-zhivoy-most: demand_evidence 2 (no payer; the only paying segment is excluded by owner; narrow audience), competition_gap 2 (panel exists free: Pixel Agents etc.; prompt hints for devs exist; non-programmer gap thinly checked, platform risk). 04-kamery-kpp: demand_evidence 3 (category paid, 'what is in hands' demand unproven, no KZ data), competition_gap 3 (plates/faces taken by Trassir, Macroscop, Axis etc.; ready carry-out module almost absent; shallow check). Self-check: `npm run --silent validate -- ../runs/WF06-20260926-01 --stage assessments` -> 'E_JSON assessment-execution.json: file is missing or unreadable', exit=1; no errors for assessment-market.json (execution file not yet written; full-stage check waits for ORCH). Limitation: the project directory is named 'sai', like candidate 02; not used as evidence.
